messages:
Lina - MKTG: Team—launch kit needs: landing hero, one benchmark slide (sparkline), compact inbound routing PNG for ops, and three microtiles (latency, cost, quality). Timeline: drafts by Tue noon. Keep copy swap-ready for EN/FR.

Ravi (Design): Copy locked? Which logo lockup and style? Illustrative or data-led?

Lina - MKTG: Headline for first pass: 'Serving Wins: predictable, economical inference.' Two bullets: 'Latency SLOs across deployments' and 'Cost controls via batching & quantization'. Stacked logo for hero. Hybrid schematic + illustration.

Mara - Creative Ops: Starter Figma file uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/serve-kit. Component set: rdw/micro-v4. Added localization tokens and export presets. I will export final png/svg if frames are named correctly.

Ava - Brand: Use approved palette only, no shadows on logos, contrast >=4.5:1. Sparkline: static SVG for slide, MP4 loop for social. Avoid old logo assets.

Ben PMM: Microtiles: dev (tokens/sec + latency), enterprise (SLA + private deploy), finance (cost/unit + batching). I'll post 1-line copy by 15:30. CTAs minimal.

Ravi (Design): Draft export spec: hero 1400x800 (svg/png), microtile 600x600 (svg/png), slide 1920x1080 (pptx/png), routing 1100x800 (svg). Will include alt text.

Figma Bot: Component "rdw/micro-v4" updated by Ravi (Design) at 2026-03-27T09:12:19Z.

Mara - Creative Ops: Handoff checklist: Figma link, png/svg exports (72dpi web, 300dpi print if requested), alt_text.md, localization keys, filename manifest. Naming pattern: rdw_launchkit_<asset>_<audience>_v1.

Lina - MKTG: Please ping #marketing-ops when hero + slide are in Figma. Need slide PNG before Wednesday rehearsal. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
